sources.title: [poll] LotF advanced AI | deepglugs on Patreon
sources.snippet: The Advanced AI feature makes enemies smarter by using a local or cloud LLM (of your choice) during combat to make combat decisions. For example, instead of simply targeting "the healer", the AI enemy may choose to target the highest damage dealer, or an enemy with a weakness to a specific type of attack.
